s: “Too many attempts, try again in a few minutes”
t: You (or someone) failed login 8+ times in 15 minutes. Wait, then log in carefully. If it persists with the right password, restart the panel service — in-memory counters reset: systemctl restart zefira .

SSH into the server and set a new one via environment + restart, or edit ZEFIRA_ADMIN_PASSWORD in /opt/zefira/.env — note this only applies to a fresh database. On an existing DB, stop the service, delete instance/zefira.db (you lose data — restore from backup after), and restart to trigger first-ru
You forgot the X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header — the CSRF guard. Browsers using the panel send it automatically.

systemctl status zefira journalctl -u zefira -n 100 --no-pager curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/login && echo PANEL-UP ss -tlnp | grep 8000 If the port is taken, another copy is already running — stop it before starting a new one.
Tokens rotate on Reset token — resend the new link. Check the user is active, not expired and not out of volume. If you renamed SUBSCRIPTION_PATH , old /sub/… links stop working.
Port 80 must be free and the domain's DNS must point at the server. Let's Encrypt rate-limits repeated issuance — wait an hour and retry. Behind Nginx, make sure the HTTP vhost exists before issuing.

s: Clients can't connect but the sub link loads
t: Open the VPN ports on the firewall ( ufw allow 443/tcp , plus inbound / Hy2 / WG ports). Verify Settings → Server domain/ports match reality, and the REALITY public key is generated. WireGuard shows a warning comment until you paste the server's public key in Settings.
